context: Provision a bounded credential per the Provision once runbook procedure, point TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND at it, and run the harness with --require against the real hosted database. Record the outcome, the doctor provenance line, and any defect the live run exposes; expect defects, because argument handling, keychain prompting behaviour, timeout headroom, and doctor output under a real backend have only been exercised against stubs. Fix what the live run finds, or open items for anything out of scope. Re-run until the harness passes twice in a row from a clean shell, once for read-write and once for a read-only credential.
description: scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh exists and its skip and --require paths are verified locally and in CI, but its pass path has never executed. No run has resolved a credential from a real secret store against a real Turso database, so the ADR 0005 G1 acceptance criterion is asserted by a harness that has not yet asserted it. This is the same shape of gap as v0.4.2: a gate that exists, looks green, and has not run the thing it exists to prove. It is also gate 1 of docs/operations/release-gates.md, so no auth-affecting release can be tagged until this has been done once.

anti_patterns.dont: Mark this complete on the strength of the harness passing its skip and --require paths
anti_patterns.instead: require a recorded run where doctor reported source TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND against a live database
anti_patterns.why: those paths are already verified and prove nothing about resolving a real credential against a real backend

anti_patterns.dont: Paste the harness output into tracker evidence verbatim
anti_patterns.instead: record the outcome and the provenance field only
anti_patterns.why: output may include the hosted host name and diagnostic detail

anti_patterns.dont: Run it once and treat a single green run as proof
anti_patterns.instead: re-run from a clean shell and cover both capabilities
anti_patterns.why: a first run can pass from a warm keychain or an already-unlocked store in a way a fresh session will not

preserves.behavior: No bearer value, hosted URL, or secret store entry name with a secret in it is recorded in tracker evidence, commit messages, or command output.
The credential used for the live run is bounded per the ADR 0004 lifetime profile and is not a non-expiring token.
The harness stays opt-in and is never wired into CI with a hosted write credential.

verifications.command: set +e; env -u TODO_DB_URL -u TODO_DB_ACCEPTANCE_URL -u TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN -u TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN -u TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND bash scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh; status=$?; set -e; test "$status" -eq 77
